title: Stoned Woman Meets Karma After Brutal Accident
description:
On January 1st, 2023, an officer responded to a car accident. Upon speaking to the driver, the officer immediately realized that she was heavily intoxicated. The woman showed no signs of awareness and continued to pass out even after the officer repeatedly called her name. The woman was taken to the hospital, and shortly after, the car's owner arrived on the scene. The female was charged with the following offences, Operating a Motor Vehicle while Intoxicated, Operating with a Suspended Driver’s License, Operating a Motor Vehicle without Proof of Insurance, display of Unauthorized Registration Plate and Unsafe Lane Deviation.
